releaseName: Live voice in the career interview for signed-in members
summary: Signed-in members can now talk a career interview topic through live: the interviewer's questions are spoken and the answers heard through Google Cloud speech in the EU, on servers that turn live voice on. Each member has 30 live minutes a day, which the operator can change; once they are used, the screen says so and the written interview stays. Earlier in this milestone: Advanced sections in the user guide, a fallback critic, and run traces from feedback notes.
knownLimitations: Inviting people to a team still goes through the API or an operator; the account menu does not list the team's people yet. Starting from a conversation needs the server's interviewer model. Agents cannot add text evidence yet (#2751). Credit packs sell only where the operator has set up Stripe; staging uses Stripe test mode. Self-service sign-up needs an invite code. The interview guide's paid walk is partial (#2623). The dating of relative source ages is not yet checked against a live search (#2579). Claude runs on the direct Claude API, outside the EU, until Claude on Vertex AI is available (#1564). French is beta until the French quality gate (milestone 83) runs. The legal pages show placeholder publisher details until the deployment sets them. Deleting an account from the screen works only for a person alone in their organisation; a team owner asks an operator. The readable copy does not yet include the career interview or research briefs.
